1 Factory uploads the batch manifest; an import Lambda loads
2 Device connects with the batch claim certificate.
3 Device sends a CSR; IoT Core returns a unique certificate
4 Device publishes RegisterThing with the token and its serial.
5 Hook checks the allow-list and marks the serial "claimed"
with a conditional write, so a serial can register only once.
6 Template creates the thing, activates the cert, attaches the
policy and adds the thing group. Device reconnects as itself.
No wildcard publish, no other thing's topics, no iot:UpdateThingShadow on
anyone else. A stolen device can only ever speak as itself.
